setting.Board.Enabled.description: Shows the parcel board in a level. The key below hides and shows it too.
setting.Board.ShowKey.description: Hides or shows the whole board.
setting.Board.OpenKey.description: Opens or closes the lists: closed, only the totals show; open, every destination with its count.
setting.Board.StartOpen.description: The lists are open when a level starts.
setting.Board.Corner.description: The corner of the screen for the board.
setting.Board.Opacity.description: How solid the background of the lists is: 0 is fully clear, 1 is solid.
setting.Board.RegionNames.description: Writes the name of a destination next to its icon.
setting.Board.Order.description: Order of the destinations in an open list: the most parcels first, or the game's order. Cat's Island always comes first.
setting.Board.HideEmptyRows.description: Leaves out destinations and sizes with no parcels; they come back as soon as there is one.
setting.Board.Scope.description: Which parcels are counted: everything in the level, or without the parcels on the boat and at customers.
setting.Lists.Heavy.description: Parcels with this mark, by destination.
setting.Lists.Fragile.description: Parcels with this mark, by destination.
setting.Lists.Dark.description: Parcels with this mark, by destination.
setting.Lists.Frozen.description: Parcels with this mark, by destination.
setting.Lists.Hot.description: Parcels with this mark, by destination.
setting.Lists.Cold.description: Parcels with this mark, by destination.
setting.Lists.Bright.description: Parcels with this mark, by destination.
setting.Lists.ContactForbidden.description: Parcels with this mark, by destination.
setting.Lists.Lover.description: Parcels with this mark, by destination.
setting.Lists.Corrupted.description: Parcels with this mark, by destination.
setting.Lists.NeedsStamps.description: Parcels for other places that still miss a stamp: destination, weight or a mark.
setting.Lists.Sizes.description: Every parcel, by size instead of destination.
